blocks.orig: The Zanzibar Bay Resort is a beautiful resort in Uroa, a village on the powdery white sandy beaches of Zanzibar’s east coast. Explore this tranquil resort and its surroundings, dive into the large infinity pool, stroll over the jetty sticking out in the ocean, or have a drink at the pool bar. The spacious rooms are divided over several buildings and floors, are well-equipped and offer views over the ocean, pool or garden. The staff is said to be amazing in catering to your every need, and the food is great. Spend your days swimming, let the kids go wild in the playground, play a round of volleyball or water polo or choose to relax with a lovely massage in the spa. The choice is yours!
blocks.html: The Zanzibar Bay Resort is a lovely resort in Uroa, a village on the powdery white beaches of Zanzibar’s east coast. Discover this peaceful resort and the area around it, take a dip in the big infinity pool, walk along the jetty that reaches out into the ocean, or order a drink at the pool bar. The roomy, well-equipped rooms are spread across several buildings and floors, with views of the ocean, the pool or the garden. Guests say the staff are wonderful at meeting your every need, and the food is great. Fill your days with swimming, let the children run free in the playground, join a game of volleyball or water polo, or unwind with a relaxing massage at the spa. It is up to you!
